name: market-activity-commands
description: Commands that must pass after every attempt. None of them needs a key or testnet HBAR.

commands.name: lint
commands.purpose: ESLint for Next.js and forge fmt --check for Solidity.

commands.name: unit
commands.purpose: Vitest unit tests, including the new activity decoder.

commands.name: contracts
commands.purpose: Forge unit tests; the feature must not touch contract behaviour.

commands.name: loaded-content
commands.purpose: Wait for a loaded market card, market 0 resolution and eight activity links with no browser errors.
